name: biogears_sepsis
description: An infection in the real BioGears 8.2.0 engine (McDaniel et al. 2019): the acute inflammatory response, its clinical signs, the endothelial leak and lymph it drives, with BioGears' own meal and water schedule; emits every simulated minute by default.

severity.description: Infection started at t = 0 ('none' for an uninfected control)

infection_mic_mg_per_L.description: Pathogen minimum inhibitory concentration (the paper's 16 mg/L)

nutrition.description: infection_scenario: BioGears' InfectionModerate schedule (water hourly, five meals in 48 h); none: no intake

iv_rate_mL_per_min.description: Infusion rate from t = 0 (no protocol only)

treatment.description: McDaniel et al. 2019 treatment protocol (viva_biogears.protocols): fluid_challenge (Fig 9), antibiotic (Fig 10), refresh_control and refresh_experimental (Figs 11-13); run to its end_h

treatment_start_h.description: Antibiotic and REFRESH start (58 for Fig 13's delayed arm)

drug_readouts.description: Drugs whose concentrations are read (readings/treatment/<drug>); default Piperacillin and Norepinephrine when treated, none otherwise. Give an untreated arm the treated arms' list to record the same stores

state_file.description: BioGears state in <runtime>/states or the package's states/ (or an absolute path)

patient_file.description: Patient file in <runtime>/patients (or a path), stabilized once (about 40 s) and then cached; replaces state_file

conditions.description: Chronic conditions applied while the patient stabilizes, e.g. {ChronicAnemia: {ReductionFactor: 0.3}}; with no patient_file, StandardMale.xml. A different patient, not a perturbation

circuit_additions.description: New path name -> {source, target, resistance_mmHg_s_per_mL}: a resistance path between two FullCardiovascular nodes in different vascular compartments, added with its compartment link so substances follow. A perturbation: the body responds over time

time_step_s.description: BioGears' solver step (validated at 0.02 s; must be < 0.1 s)
